name: Juic International Corporation
summary: Juic International Corporation serves Taiwan's computer and consumer electronics manufacturing sectors by supplying essential processing materials. The company's extensive product offerings include LED and semiconductor components, cosmetic materials, optical solutions for touch panels, thermal management materials, various electronic materials, and electromagnetic interference (EMI) products. Founded in 1982, this Taipei-based firm was originally known as H&T Electronics Co. Ltd. before rebranding to Juic International Corporation in June 2015.
